<div class="card-body">
'''R2-X2 (Artoo-Extoo)''' is a [[Light]] [[Character]] ([[Droid]]) from [[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">Ｒ２－Ｘ２（アートゥーエックストゥー）</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">宇宙戦闘機に乗っている間、戦闘力、回避値、航行速度に＋１。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-24o-Video.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">宇宙戦闘機パイロットの操縦補佐ドロイド。ハイパースペース突入用の座標を１０組まで記憶可能。各種ツールとインターフェースを内蔵。ヤヴィン基地ではレッド１０に搭載。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' R2-X2 (Artoo-Extoo).

'''Card text:''' While aboard a starfighter, power, maneuver, and hyperspeed +1.

'''Lore:''' An astromech droid that assists starfighter pilots. It can store up to ten hyperspace jump coordinates. Built-in tools and interfaces. Assigned to Red 10 at Yavin Base.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[R2-X2 (Artoo-Extoo)]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 41, 97. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
